    Senior Civil Engineer (Road & Drainage Works)

    • Job Type Full Time
    • Qualification BA/BSc/HND
    • Experience
    • Location Abuja
    • Job Field Engineering / Technical 

    Job Purpose

    • To provide technical leadership, supervision and coordination of road construction and drainage projects, ensuring that all engineering activities are executed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, quality standards, project schedules and budgetary requirements.
    • The successful candidate must possess extensive practical experience in road construction, rehabilitation and drainage infrastructure, with the ability to manage complex projects from commencement to completion.

    Key Responsibilties
    Road Construction and Project Execution:

    • Lead and supervise road construction, rehabilitation and upgrading works, including earthworks, subgrade preparation, sub-base, base course, asphalt laying and finishing.
    • Ensure all construction activities comply with approved engineering designs, specifications and project requirements.
    • Provide technical direction to site engineers, supervisors and construction teams to achieve project targets.

    Drainage and Infrastructure Works:

    • Oversee the construction of stormwater drainage systems, culverts, concrete drains, channels, bridges and other associated infrastructure.
    • Review drainage designs, levels, gradients, alignments and hydraulic requirements to ensure effective water management.
    • Ensure proper integration of drainage structures with road alignments and pavement construction.

    Technical Supervision and Quality Control:

    • Review engineering drawings, method statements, technical submissions and construction procedures.
    • Ensure appropriate material testing, field density tests, concrete cube tests, compaction tests and other quality assurance procedures are conducted.
    • Identify and resolve technical challenges, construction defects and deviations from approved specifications.

    Project Planning, Cost and Resource Management:

    • Develop and monitor construction work programmes, project schedules and daily, weekly and monthly work targets.
    • Coordinate the utilisation of manpower, construction equipment, materials and other project resources.
    • Monitor project progress, identify delays and implement corrective measures to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery.

    Project Reporting and Stakeholder Coordination:

    • Provide regular technical and progress reports to Management, highlighting achievements, challenges, resource requirements and project risks.
    • Coordinate with consultants, clients, subcontractors, project managers and relevant regulatory authorities.
    • Ensure proper technical documentation, measurement records, project handover documentation and as-built drawings are maintained.
